<thought>We need to find the retrosynthetic template that matches the described cyclization of chalcones to flavanones. Since the target SMILES is not provided, we first search the template catalog using the functional groups formed/broken and bond changes described in the prompt. This will give us candidate template IDs that we can later apply once the target molecule is known.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aromatic hydroxyls", "ketones"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
